tests.name: SPI PIO Full Duplex
tests.description: Validate SPI full-duplex transfers using CPU-driven (PIO) RX/TX.
dependencies: Valid loopback or SPI slave device available
tests.expected_result: RX data matches TX data across transfer length; no frame/overrun/underrun errors; status registers clean.

tests.name: SPI PIO RX, DMA TX
tests.description: Validate hybrid path where TX uses DMA and RX uses PIO.
dependencies: DMA engine configured for SPI TX
tests.expected_result: DMA-driven TX completes without errors, PIO RX collects expected data; descriptor/status indicate success.

tests.name: SPI Register Write/Read Test
tests.description: Sanity check for SPI register accessibility, default resets, and read-back equivalence.
tests.expected_result: Writes to R/W registers read back identically; reset-only fields match documented reset values; RO registers unchanged.
